title: From the Vault: Realms: card flavor text

paragraphs.text: There is no glory to be gained in the kingdom of the dead. —Vec tomb inscription
Spring is the most beautiful season in the grove, when the new leaves open from their ember-buds in a race of leaping flames.
If it can't be had here, it can't be had on any world.
"Yawgmoth's corpse is a wound in the universe. His foul blood seeps out, infecting the land with his final curse." —Lord Windgrace
It is everywhere you've ever been.
